name: HSBC Holdings
title: Interim Results 2026 Presentation to Investors and Analysts - Transcript

read.thesis: HSBC Q2 26 revenue +7% to $19bn, PBT +13% to $10.3bn, RoTE 19.5%; Banking NII guidance raised to at least $46bn and simplification saves lifted to $2bn, but 2027 investment acceleration may add costs.

triggers.label: Banking NII guidance raised to $46bn
triggers.quote: We are upgrading our full-year Banking NII guidance to at least $46 billion.

triggers.label: Simplification saves raised $1.5bn → $2bn
triggers.quote: We are today revising upwards our total target savings to $2 billion.

triggers.label: Q2 deposits +$46bn, half about short-term
triggers.quote: I will highlight that about half of the CIB deposit growth in the quarter was large and short term.

triggers.label: 2027 investment may be accelerated
triggers.quote: This gives us strong confidence to bring forward our planned investments, so we may therefore add to investment growth in 2027.

guidance.quote: We are upgrading our full-year Banking NII guidance to at least $46 billion.
We are today revising upwards our total target savings to $2 billion.
we continue to guide on around 1% cost growth for the full year 2026.
We reiterate our full-year 2026 credit guidance of around 45 basis points.
revenue rising to 5% year-on-year growth by 2028, excluding notable items.
Return on tangible equity of 17% or better, excluding notable items each year.
